_comment: Every file the two products have to agree on, with its SHA-256. A contract changes with its version, in its owner's project first -
then `python -m arx_tools.contracts --update` here and the identical copy in the other project. See contracts/README.md.

contracts.name: arx-export
contracts.what: history of the original software for arx-free - the file, and since v2 the route GET /api/export?since= on Insight's local listener (same lines; the header's format name stays arx-export-1 because no line changed); v3 the e-mail, v4 the coaching block, v5 (2026-09-24) the goal's fatigue_target_pct on the athlete line and the original's current range_of_motion lines (footer ranges); v4 stays listed until arx-free adopts v5

contracts.name: arx-free-sets
contracts.what: what ARX Insight reads from arx-free's SQLite database (tables, columns, meanings: source NULL = arx-free's own recording, 'arx-original' = a copy; the curve format), the three settings original / arx-free / both without duplicates, who is who (e-mail first, import link second, names never); v2 (2026-09-24): the live coach's notes sets.coach_json (schema 5) and what Insight computes from them (coach_effects); v1 stays listed until arx-free adopts v2

contracts.name: effort-v3
contracts.what: did the set produce fatigue - rule and shared test vectors

contracts.name: hold
contracts.what: did the static hold produce fatigue - rule (held force vs sustained force, persistence, letting go ends the hold, live ending) and shared test vectors incl. the owner's real test hold

contracts.name: vocabulary
contracts.what: the words a person reads or hears for the fatigue rule (report, coach, live display); v2 (2026-09-24): a set below the target is 'a real load - the target sits N % higher' (never 'half the stimulus'), the repeat is an offer, four framing rules (positive first and true, gain frame, own reference, offers not orders); v1 stays listed until arx-free adopts v2

contracts.name: modes
contracts.what: a set's mode (movement x ending x phase), Output and the machine's own inroad scale - definitions and field names; v2 added the ending 'fatigue'; v3: a person ends an Inroad set (the original never ends a set by itself and judges nothing for a hold - owner's own test 2026-09-22), a recommended hold = static/time with a fatigue target (arx-free: static/fatigue), ONE hold rule to come (hold-1)

contracts.name: exercise-coaching
contracts.what: how an exercise is done on the machine - start, path, end, cues by phase, safety points (German + English)

contracts.name: insight-progress
contracts.what: the shape of report.history.progress_factors (overall + exercises[] with status, change / rate figures, points, interp) that arx-free's trend view shows - a rename of a pinned key is a new version (arx-free's request 8, 2026-09-24)
